test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Theirs is a __clandestine__ affair.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e.** 'Known'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Clandestine** means kept secret or done secretively, especially because illicit.(गुप्त)

 
 
• **Example:** They met in the park for a clandestine meeting so that no one would see them.
 
 
 
• **'Known'** is something recognized, familiar, or within the scope of knowledge.(ज्ञात)
 
 
• **Example: **Their relationship was well known amongst their circle of friends.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is 'Option 1' i.e. '**Known'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2** 'Private':** Private could be seen as a synonym rather than an antonym for clandestine as it also refers to something that is not open or publicly known.(निजी)
 
• Option 3 **'Sneaky': **Sneaky also corresponds with clandestine as it refers to the behavior that is secretive or not honest. (चुराई-छुपाई).
 
• Option 4** 'Illicit':** Illicit means forbidden by law, rules, or custom, often associates with clandestine as activities that are illicit tend to be conducted clandestinely.(अवैध)
